verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that you can choose to have your Playwright/Puppeteer code connect directly over CDP instead of letting Browser Use drive the browser. The docs also describe launching a cloud browser, connecting to its CDP URL, and stopping it. 'Browser Infrastructure' is positioned as a remote browser for your own agents. missing for 10: detailed Playwright/Puppeteer connection examples or code-level docs in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration that existing scripts work unchanged.
